file: File:Damage in Gaza Strip during the October 2023 - 29.jpg

notes: Commons featured picture; Wafa release via VRTS ticket 2023102210002528. Strike dated 9 Oct in the description, EXIF 10 Oct. A maroon cushion/fabric lies in the rubble lower-left: checked at full size, it is a textile, no person.

file: File:Humanitarian Assistance over Gaza, Super Hercules coming with a Special Delivery - 8281513.jpg
author: U.S. Air Force courtesy photo (DVIDS 8281513, credited to Staff Sgt. Jasmonet Holmes)
desc_en: A U.S. Air Force C-130J Super Hercules aircraft airdrops pallets of food and water over Gaza, Mar. 11, 2024. Delivering humanitarian aid through an airdrop ensures the aid is received by civilians most in need without delay for communities which may be difficult to reach on the ground due to geography. (U.S. Air Force courtesy photo)
caption_ar: طائرة نقل أمريكية من طراز C-130J تلقي منصات غذاء ومياه فوق قطاع غزة، 11 مارس 2024.
notes: View from inside the aircraft as pallets leave the ramp. Many more PD airdrop photos exist (1-29 March 2024) if a ground view is preferred.

file: File:Humanitarian Aid at the Kerem Shalom Crossing Point (9389533).jpg
author: Sgt. 1st Class Malcolm Cohens-Ashley, U.S. Army
desc_en: Humanitarian aid awaits pick-up at the Kerem Shalom crossing point on Nov. 13, 2025, in Israel. The CMCC is designed to help facilitate the flow of humanitarian, logistical, and security assistance into Gaza. The coordination center is also monitoring implementation of the ceasefire agreement and transition to civilian governance. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Malcolm Cohens-Ashley.)
caption_ar: مساعدات إنسانية بانتظار نقلها عند معبر كرم أبو سالم (كيرم شالوم)، 13 نوفمبر 2025.
notes: Taken by the US-led Civil-Military Coordination Center after the October 2025 ceasefire. Pallets in an empty yard, no people.

file: File:Humanitarian Aid at the Zikim Crossing (9417185).jpg
author: Sgt. 1st Class Malcolm Cohens-Ashley, U.S. Army
place: Zikim crossing, north of the Gaza Strip
desc_en: Trucks carrying humanitarian aid move through a checkpoint at the Zikim Crossing Point on Nov. 25, 2025, in Israel. The United States is working with the international community to facilitate the flow of humanitarian assistance to civilians in Gaza. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Malcolm Cohens-Ashley.)
caption_ar: شاحنات مساعدات تعبر نقطة تفتيش عند معبر زيكيم شمال قطاع غزة، 25 نوفمبر 2025.
notes: US Army photo; trucks only.

notes: Hebrew description: 'blocking of the aid trucks to the Gaza Strip'; place from the Commons category 'Kerem Shalom crossing'. Own work, 1600 px. Useful for obstruction-of-aid files.

notes: Doubt on place: the file only says 'visits Egypt and Rafah border' (probably the al-Arish logistics hub) - do not caption it as the crossing gate. Forklift and Red Crescent volunteers. No free photo of trucks at the Rafah crossing itself was found.

caption_ar: نازحون يتجمعون لتلقي وجبات من مطبخ خيري في دير البلح وسط قطاع غزة، 26 يونيو 2024.
notes: UNRWA, 1200 px, UNRWA logo watermark. Children in the crowd but no close-up distress. Rejected the sharper '...line up to receive food... 2.jpg' (children's faces pressed to bars in close-up).

file: File:Foreign Minister Penny Wong Wreath Laying at International Humanitarian Memorial (000148147).jpg
author: Alexandra Peek / DFAT (Australia)
desc_en: Penny Wong, Minister for Foreign Affairs, laid a wreath in memorial of Lalzawmi 'Zomi' Frankcom, the International Aid Worker from the World Central Kitchen charity, killed while working in Gaza with six of her colleagues, at Canberra's International Humanitarian Memorial. Minister Wong was joined by Marc Purcell, CEO of the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), and staff from ACFID and the...
caption_ar: وزيرة الخارجية الأسترالية بيني وونغ تضع إكليلا في النصب التذكاري للعاملين الإنسانيين في كانبرا تكريما لزومي فرانكوم، العاملة في المطبخ المركزي العالمي التي قتلت مع ستة من زملائها في غزة، 3 أبريل 2024.
notes: Substitute: no freely licensed photo of the WCK convoy vehicles hit on 1 April 2024 exists on Commons. Licence via the {{DFAT}} template (CC BY 4.0).

author: Cameron Smith / The White House
desc_en: Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff attends a memorial for the seven World Central Kitchen humanitarian aid workers killed in an April 1 drone strike in Gaza, Thursday, April 25, 2024, at National Cathedral in Washington, D.C. (Official White House Photo by Cameron Smith)
caption_ar: حفل تأبين في الكاتدرائية الوطنية بواشنطن للعاملين السبعة في المطبخ المركزي العالمي الذين قتلوا في ضربة بطائرة مسيرة في غزة يوم 1 أبريل 2024، 25 أبريل 2024.
notes: Official White House photo (PD). Mourners seated; non-graphic. Also a substitute for the missing vehicle photo.

file: File:10 02 2025 Khallet Athaba 10.jpg
author: Mediterranea Saving Humans
place: Khallet a-Dabe', Masafer Yatta, south Hebron hills
desc_en: On February 10, 2025, in the Palestinian village of Khallet Athaba', Israeli forces carry out demolitions of Palestinian homes. In total, eight dwellings are destroyed over approximately two hours: five houses, one inhabited tent, and two inhabited caves. A bulldozer and an excavator operate on site, alongside several soldiers, police officers, and a settler security vehicle. All demolished structures were...
caption_ar: حفارة تهدم منشآت فلسطينية بحضور جنود إسرائيليين في خلة الضبع بمسافر يطا جنوب الخليل، 10 فبراير 2025.
notes: Italian NGO's own work, CC0. Description: Israeli forces demolished eight dwellings that day. More demolition frames exist for 26 Feb, 5 May, 11 Jun and 17 Sep 2025.

file: File:19 02 2025 Umm al Kheir 01.jpg
author: Mediterranea Saving Humans
desc_en: On February 10, 2025, in the Palestinian village of Umm al Kheir, Israeli forces demolished three Palestinian homes.
caption_ar: أنقاض منازل هدمتها القوات الإسرائيلية في قرية أم الخير بمسافر يطا يوم 10 فبراير 2025، في صورة ملتقطة في 19 فبراير 2025.
notes: Description dates the demolition to 10 Feb 2025; EXIF/page date 19 Feb 2025 - caption carries both. Skipped the 'Umm al-Khair ... Carmel' series: CC BY-SA 2.5 claimed for the village council without a VRTS ticket.

file: File:07 04 2025 Umm al Kheir 02.jpg
author: Mediterranea Saving Humans
desc_en: On April 7, 2025, in the Palestinian village of Umm al Kheir, Israeli settlers set up an outpost by placing a container on Palestinian land.
caption_ar: حاوية وضعها مستوطنون إسرائيليون لإقامة بؤرة استيطانية على أرض فلسطينية في أم الخير، 7 أبريل 2025.
notes: Own work, CC0. Settler outpost container on Palestinian land per the description.

file: File:25 01 2025 Tuba 01.jpg
author: Mediterranea Saving Humans
desc_en: On January 25, 2025, in the Palestinian village of Tuba, Israeli settlers attacked and damaged Palestinian property. The victims report that six armed and masked settlers, possibly from the Havat Ma'on outpost, entered private property, set a Palestinian car on fire, damaged three rooms of a house, smashed two windows, damaged dairy-processing equipment, and stole a phone.
caption_ar: سيارة فلسطينية محترقة بعد هجوم مستوطنين على قرية طوبا في مسافر يطا، 25 يناير 2025.
notes: Description relays the residents' account (six armed, masked settlers burned a car and damaged a house). Companion frame '25 01 2025 Tuba 02.jpg' shows the vandalised dairy room.

file: File:04 10 2025 Susiya 04.jpg
author: Mediterranea Saving Humans
desc_en: On October 4, 2025, in the Palestinian village of Susiya, a group of settlers attacked a house, breaking a window and setting fire to a car parked in the courtyard, causing damage to the house.
caption_ar: واجهة منزل في سوسيا جنوب الخليل اسودت بعد أن أضرم مستوطنون النار في سيارة بفنائه، 4 أكتوبر 2025.
notes: Portrait 900x1600. Skipped: Huwara 2023 (nothing free) and the Duma April 2024 CC0 set (uploaded by a third party 'from its owner', no permission ticket).

file: File:PisgatZeevJuly142023 03.jpg
author: Hagai Agmon-Snir
desc_en: The Shu'fat Palestinian refugee camp, bordered by the Israeli West Bank wall, facing the Israeli settlement of Pisgat Ze'ev. East Jerusalem, occupied West Bank, 2023.
caption_ar: مخيم شعفاط للاجئين في القدس الشرقية يحده جدار الفصل وتقابله مستوطنة بسغات زئيف، 14 يوليو 2023.
notes: Own work, 4000 px; the wall runs through the frame.

caption_ar: جدار الفصل الإسرائيلي المحيط بمدينة بيت لحم في الضفة الغربية، 4 فبراير 2019.

notes: Own work, CC0; warm-toned processing.
